summary: Verified the PublishDrawer infinite-spinner bug fix and the new live publish timer. End-to-end essay publish completed in <1s with drawer auto-closing and success toast. The 45s axios global timeout has no negative effect on regular pages (Today/Feed/Members/News/Podcasts/Write all load cleanly without axios timeout/abort errors).

minor.issue: Pre-existing 401/404 console noise on initial load of / and /feed (unrelated to publish bug). Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Composer.jsx submit() correctly closes drawer + flips posting=false BEFORE awaiting any cleanup (reset() and onPosted() are non-blocking). This is the right fix for the infinite spinner.
ECONNABORTED branch maps to 'Publish timed out…' toast and clears posting state — verified logic by code review (live timeout simulation skipped per request).
PublishDrawer renders [data-testid=drawer-publish-timer] only while posting; clock SVG + '{n}s' counter visible. Counter updates every 250ms via setInterval in Composer.jsx (lines 53-59).
axios timeout: 45000 in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js is shared by all GETs (Today/Feed/etc). All those pages load normally — timeout doesn't truncate any legitimate request.
Minor: tiptap 'Duplicate extension names found: [link]' warning surfaces on essay editor mount — cosmetic, unrelated to this bug.
seed_data_creation: Created one published essay 'Frontend Agent Test' (~232 char body) via the live UI flow. It now appears as Published #8 in the writer desk. Safe to keep or main agent can delete via admin tools.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Publish flow E2E: /write → New essay button → composer-mode-essay → essay-editor-markdown → editor-title-input + editor-body-textarea (>=100 chars for essay) → open-publish-drawer-button → drawer-final-publish-button. Drawer auto-closes when POST /api/posts returns. Timer testid: drawer-publish-timer (only present while posting). Session token: tok_smoke_admin_v2.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Composer.submit() awaited reset() (which does DELETE /drafts/mine) and onPosted() (which reloaded writer stats) inside the try block before setPosting(false). On production those calls intermittently stalled, leaving posting=true forever -> infinite spinner. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/Composer.jsx lines 286-300 closes drawer + sets posting=false immediately after the POST succeeds, then fires reset().catch(()=>{}) and onPosted() as fire-and-forget promises. Verified live: drawer closed in 0.20s after POST /api/posts -> 200.

test_observations.success_toast_text: Essay published. Emails are going out now.
